pages.title: Orders Understood
pages.text: A Shieldman’s Table supports developing the squad and bread gives a simple provision reserve for future orders.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use the native management screen and available follow, hold or move orders. PvP and a second player are unnecessary; server team diplomacy is an optional separate setting.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use native recruit management screens to assign groups and command them. Group orders coordinate several units rather than requiring per-unit control.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use the mod's team management for a multiplayer group before planning battles. The native system supports team/PvP relations; it does not imply Villager Workers is installed.
